requirements: R1: Fix SixSigmaAuditService calculateFullSixSigmaAudit to bypass project coercion.

slices.title: Fix SixSigmaAuditService Null Coercion
slices.jtbd: When implementing the SixSigmaAuditService fix for this epic, I want to remove the invalid null coercion, so that the endpoint functions correctly.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the SixSigmaAuditService is called with a null context,
When calculateFullSixSigmaAudit is invoked,
Then it delegates to calculateSixSigmaAuditInternal(null) without project coercion.
Given the patch is applied, When the test suite runs, Then Unit and E2E tests thoroughly verify the SixSigmaAuditService logic.

requirements: R1: Update AutoMergeService to match PRs even if session PR URL is null.

slices.title: Fix AutoMergeService PR Reconciliation
slices.jtbd: When implementing the reconciliation fix for this epic, I want to match PRs accurately without session URL, so that successfully delivered work is correctly recorded as merged.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a merged PR event where session PR URL is null,
When AutoMergeService processes the event,
Then it successfully reconciles the PR to its task using origin_feature_id.
Given the patch is applied, When the test suite runs, Then Unit and E2E tests thoroughly verify the reconciliation logic.

epics.title: System Measurement (GQM) for Follow-up Patches
epics.jtbd: When operating the knowledge base with new patches, I want to measure calculation and reconciliation success rates (Question 1: Are SixSigma audits succeeding? Question 2: Are PRs matching?), so that I know the patches resolved the issues.
requirements: R1: Measure successful SixSigma calculation events.
R2: Measure successful PR reconciliation events.

slices.title: Implement Telemetry for Follow-up Patches
slices.jtbd: When implementing telemetry for this epic, I want to record successful calculations and reconciliations, so that the patches are measured effectively.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the patched services,
When operations succeed,
Then successful events are logged.
Given the telemetry logic is added, When the test suite runs, Then Unit and E2E tests thoroughly verify the metrics.

requirements: R1: Implement SPA Navigation Hub layout and Tab Routing.
R2: Ensure WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility for navigation elements.

slices.title: Implement SPA Navigation Hub
slices.jtbd: When implementing the navigation hub for this epic, I want to enable seamless tab switching, so that employees have a unified workflow.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user on the SPA Navigation Hub,
When they click a tab,
Then the content switches without a page reload and the URL updates.
Given the mobile view is active, When tested via Playwright, Then interactive zones are at least 44x44px and valid 1440px and 375px PNG screenshots are saved at precise designated .eneik/records/ paths.
Given the UI is updated, When the HTML harness is checked, Then Svelte component changes are manually mirrored in the corresponding standalone HTML harness file.
Given the implementation is complete, When the test suite runs, Then Unit and E2E tests thoroughly verify the SPA navigation.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce page load time between sections by 80%

epics.title: System Measurement (GQM) for SPA Navigation
epics.jtbd: When accessing the platform, I want to measure navigation success rates and times (Question 1: Are users successfully navigating between tabs without reloads? Question 2: Is navigation time under 100ms?), so that I know the SPA workflow is efficient.
requirements: R1: Measure SPA tab transition times and counts.

slices.title: Implement SPA Telemetry
slices.jtbd: When implementing telemetry for this epic, I want to record transition times, so that navigation efficiency is measured.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user navigating the SPA,
When a tab switch occurs,
Then the transition time is recorded in frontend telemetry.
Given the frontend telemetry is implemented, When the test suite runs, Then Unit and E2E tests thoroughly verify the telemetry.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% telemetry coverage for tab switches
